evaluation: One next tool call only. An edit recovery is accepted when it calls read_file on broken.py or edit_file with the exact old and corrected new text. A task recovery is accepted when it calls task_list or task_output with the full observed ID. Any other response, malformed output, error or timeout is not accepted. No requested tool is executed.
limitations: Synthetic one-step replay on one GPU-backed local model; not an end-to-end coding task, a 16 GB CPU qualification, or a release gate. Repeats are correlated and selection followed observed failures.
